name: Melwas

attributes.attribute: the Welsh form of the name Meleagant
the king who took Queen Guinevere
Gildas settled the argument between him and Arthur

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Melwas is another name for Meleagant. In Arthurian legend he was the king who took Queen Guinevere. In one Welsh poem there is a dialogue between him and Gwenhwyfar. The early source makes the saint Gildas settle the quarrel between Melwas and King Arthur.

okr.objective: Document Melwas, the Welsh name of Meleagant.
key_results: he is the same as Meleagant
